rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a film or game soundtrack, including the music itself and its released recording.

example.english: The soundtrack of this film is great, so I bought a copy right after watching it.
example.traditional: 呢套戲嘅原聲帶好好聽，我睇完即刻買咗張返屋企。

rows.note: Use this for the music used as part of a film or game, rather than specifically for the commercial album.

example.english: The soundtrack in this film is spot-on and makes the tense scenes even more exciting.
example.traditional: 呢套戲嘅配樂好到位，緊張場面一響起就更加刺激。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 ge3 pui3 ngok6 hou2 dou3 wai2 gan2 zoeng1 coeng4 min2 jat1 hoeng2 hei2 zau6 gang3 gaa1 ci3 gik1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the soundtrack is a commercially released album.

example.english: I have already pre-ordered the film's soundtrack album and can collect it on release day.
example.traditional: 我已經預購咗嗰套戲嘅原聲大碟，出碟嗰日就可以攞。
